source: Selected PATH nodes, node/header data and final ordinary ARRAY rows/planes; static comma/chained paths, named components, foreign roots and executing linked owners
registration: Selected concrete data schema and traversed metadata only; existing node required but values need not be initialized
capture: Retain original selected cells; charge leaves and packed/pending bytes before encoding; check source/status reference locations and retained list length before publication
encoding: Exact registered identity/dimensions/capacity and existing little-endian complete-record layout; immutable encoded bytes retain their value across later stream preparation
publication: Changed bindings or retained-list resizing preserve completed host effects, ring/pending data and start counts; no record or flush publication
persistence: Ordinary roots, selected schema and independent bytes, without live row/node subscription or saved selection
